items.name: 星球空降服（第7小队）第2版
items.obtain: When you arrive in the Flooded Commercial Sector, exit the monorail and look to the left. Continue down the stairs here and proceed into the half-open door to find a black box containing Nano Suit - Planet Diving Suit (7th) V2.
items.obtain_zh: 抵达淹水商业区后，出单轨列车并向左看。沿楼梯往下走，进入半开的门，里面有黑色箱子，可获得纳米战衣——星球空降服（第7小队）第2版。

items.name: 星球空降服（第7小队）第3版
items.obtain: Replaces Planet Diving Suit (7th) V2 on NG+. Exit the monorail in the Flooded Commercial Sector and head left down the stairs into the half-open door.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换星球空降服（第7小队）第2版。在淹水商业区出单轨列车，向左走下楼，进入半开的门。

items.name: 星球空降防护服（第7小队）
items.obtain: Replaces Planet Diving Suit (7th) V3 on NG++. Exit the monorail in the Flooded Commercial Sector and head left down the stairs into the half-open door.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换星球空降服（第7小队）第3版。在淹水商业区出单轨列车，向左走下楼，进入半开的门。

items.name: 废土冒险家
items.obtain: After draining the water during the side quest "Oblivion", make your way to the very bottom of the now drained Flooded Commercial Sector. Follow this lower path to the very end, defeating a Cricket Slasher as you go. At the end you will find a black box with Nano Suit - Wasteland Adventurer.
items.obtain_zh: 完成支线任务《遗忘》排干水后，前往淹水商业区现已干涸的最底部。沿下方路径走到尽头，途中击败一只蟋蟀斩击者。尽头有黑色箱子，可获得纳米战衣——废土冒险家。

items.name: 废土探索者
items.obtain: Replaces Wasteland Adventurer on NG+. Found at the bottom of the drained Flooded Commercial Sector after completing the "Oblivion" side quest.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换废土冒险家。完成《遗忘》支线任务后，在排干水的淹水商业区底部找到。

items.name: 乌莲
items.obtain: Replaces Wasteland Explorer on NG++. Found at the bottom of the drained Flooded Commercial Sector after completing the "Oblivion" side quest.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换废土探索者。完成《遗忘》支线任务后，在排干水的淹水商业区底部找到。

items.name: 赤血丹心
items.obtain: Once you are able to use the cranes in the Construction Zone, use the right-hand crane first. Use this to push the girder into the sculpted wall to the right of the sewer entrance. This will break it, revealing a small room behind. Position the girder on the crane so that you can jump across to it and then over to the newly revealed room. You will find a black box here containing Nano Suit - Red Passion.
items.obtain_zh: 在施工区可以使用吊车后，先用右侧吊车把钢梁推向下水道入口右侧的雕塑墙，砸开后露出隐藏房间。调整吊车上的钢梁位置，跳上钢梁再跳进新出现的房间，里面有黑色箱子，可获得纳米战衣——赤血丹心。

items.name: 翡翠热情
items.obtain: Replaces Red Passion on NG+. Found in the hidden room in the Construction Zone, accessed by using the crane to break through the sculpted wall.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换赤血丹心。位于施工区隐藏房间内，用吊车砸开雕塑墙进入。

items.name: 芍药独韵
items.obtain: Replaces Emerald Passion on NG++. Found in the hidden room in the Construction Zone, accessed by using the crane to break through the sculpted wall.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换翡翠热情。位于施工区隐藏房间内，用吊车砸开雕塑墙进入。

items.name: 狂飙车手
items.obtain: Head northeast of the Solar Tower and climb the cliffs up to the large open area to the northwest. Head east and drop down onto the rocks, here you will find a black box here containing Nano Suit - Racer's High.
items.obtain_zh: 从太阳塔向东北方走，攀上悬崖到达西北方向的开阔地带。向东走并跳落到岩石上，此处有黑色箱子，可获得纳米战衣——狂飙车手。

items.name: 极速快感
items.obtain: Replaces Racer's High on NG+. Head northeast of the Solar Tower, climb the cliffs to the open area, then drop down onto the rocks to the east.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换狂飙车手。从太阳塔向东北攀上悬崖到开阔地带，再向东跳落到岩石上。

items.name: 知觉活肤紧身服
items.obtain: Replaces Speeder's High on NG++. Head northeast of the Solar Tower, climb the cliffs to the open area, then drop down onto the rocks to the east.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换极速快感。从太阳塔向东北攀上悬崖到开阔地带，再向东跳落到岩石上。

items.name: 空乘风
items.obtain: Head east from the Altess Levoire entrance, go through the gate and then climb up the cliff face to the northeast of you. Follow the cliffs up and to the west. Then, you'll have to do some more platforming involving jumping across poles. Once you reach the other side, before crossing the bridge, you will find a black box with Nano Suit - Crew Style.
items.obtain_zh: 从阿尔忒斯勒瓦尔入口向东走，穿过大门，攀上你东北方的崖壁。沿悬崖向上并向西前进，然后做一系列借助柱子跳跃的平台动作。到达对面后，在过桥前可找到黑色箱子，里面有纳米战衣——通勤装。

items.name: 通勤装
items.obtain: Replaces Crew Style on NG++. Head east from the Altess Levoire entrance, through the gate, up the cliff face, and across the poles to the black box before the bridge.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换通勤装。从阿尔忒斯勒瓦尔入口向东，穿门、上崖壁、跃过柱子，在桥前的黑色箱子中找到。

items.obtain_zh: 在西部大峡谷补给营地以西的飞船集装箱上使用密码 βθαλδζ（委托《招募密码专家》内容）。

items.name: 赛博魔法师
items.obtain: Drop down, push the orange box through the main gate and onto the big platform. Then jump up and climb the rope, interact with the chest, and shoot all the targets except the red ones before they disappear. Do that and this nano suit is all yours.
items.obtain_zh: 跳下去，把橙色箱子推过大门推上大平台。然后跳上去抓住绳索攀爬，与宝箱互动，并在目标消失前射中除红色以外的所有目标，即可获得此纳米战衣。

items.name: 赛博诡术士
items.obtain: Replaces Cyber Magician on NG+. Complete the same shooting challenge: push the orange box, climb the rope, and hit all targets except red ones.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换赛博魔法师。完成同样的射击挑战：推橙色箱子、爬绳索、射中除红色外的所有目标。

items.name: 莹白珍珠
items.obtain: Replaces Cyber Trickster on NG++. Complete the same shooting challenge: push the orange box, climb the rope, and hit all targets except red ones.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换赛博诡术士。完成同样的射击挑战：推橙色箱子、爬绳索、射中除红色外的所有目标。

items.name: 黄色运动服
items.obtain: In a chest where the Brute came from in the Forbidden Area. Directly behind Tommy's body.
items.obtain_zh: 在禁区蛮兽出没处的宝箱里，就在汤米尸体正后方。

items.name: 活力运动服
items.obtain: Replaces Sporty Yellow on NG+. Found in the chest behind Tommy's body in the Forbidden Area.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换黄色运动服。位于禁区汤米尸体后方的宝箱里。

items.name: 极致兔女郎
items.obtain: Replaces Sporty Energy on NG++. Found in the chest behind Tommy's body in the Forbidden Area.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换活力运动服。位于禁区汤米尸体后方的宝箱里。

items.name: 休闲针织裙装
items.obtain: In the next open-ish area, there's a train carriage (after a fight with a handful of enemies) on the south wall. Down the end is a crate with this Nano Suit inside.
items.obtain_zh: 在下一个较开阔的区域，与若干敌人战斗后，南墙处有一节列车车厢，尽头箱子内有此纳米战衣。

items.name: 舒适针织裙装
items.obtain: Replaces Daily Knitted Dress on NG+. Found in the crate at the end of the train carriage on the south wall.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换休闲针织裙装。位于南墙列车车厢尽头的箱子里。

items.name: 水珍珠
items.obtain: Replaces Comfort Knitted Dress on NG++. Found in the crate at the end of the train carriage on the south wall.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换舒适针织裙装。位于南墙列车车厢尽头的箱子里。

items.name: 休闲吉祥物装
items.obtain: If you head back up and head south-southwest a Skull will crash through the wall. Defeat the enemies and go into the room where the Skull crashed through from.
items.obtain_zh: 返回上方后朝西南偏南走，会有一只骷髅撞破墙壁。击败敌人后进入骷髅撞出的房间。

items.name: 舒适吉祥物装
items.obtain: Replaces Daily Mascot on NG+. Found in the room the Skull crashed through from, south-southwest after heading back up.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换休闲吉祥物装。位于返回上方后西南偏南处骷髅撞破的房间里。

items.name: 暗影忍者装
items.obtain: Replaces Comfort Mascot on NG++. Found in the room the Skull crashed through from, south-southwest after heading back up.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换舒适吉祥物装。位于返回上方后西南偏南处骷髅撞破的房间里。

items.name: 亮银忍者装
items.obtain: Replaces Orca Techie on NG++. Found behind the Supply Camp on the east side.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换奥卡技术员。位于东侧补给营地后方。

items.name: 休闲活力装
items.obtain: As you leave, look up to the right of the entrance, there's a chest there with this nano suit design inside.
items.obtain_zh: 离开时抬头看入口右侧，那里的宝箱内有此纳米战衣设计图。

items.name: 舒适活力装
items.obtain: Replaces Daily Force on NG+. Found in the chest up to the right of the entrance as you leave.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换休闲活力装。位于离开时入口右上方处的宝箱里。

items.name: 星球空降服（第5小队）
items.obtain: Replaces Comfort Force on NG++. Found in the chest up to the right of the entrance as you leave.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换舒适活力装。位于离开时入口右上方处的宝箱里。

items.name: 海洋之丝
items.obtain: After obtaining [[collectibles/documents#strange-information|Strange Information]] from completing the [[walkthroughs/bulletin-board-requests/strange-signal|Strange Signal]] bulletin board request, fast travel to the [[collectibles/camps#temporary-armoury-supply-camp|Temporary Armoury Supply Camp]], head left, and take the elevator back up. Follow the path right past the Cricket Butchers, the dev room door is on the left, passcode θεθλβλ. The Ocean String chest is in the second chamber, passcode θβδζκε.
items.obtain_zh: 完成布告栏委托《奇怪信号》获得【奇怪信息】后，快速传送至【临时军械库补给营地】，向左走上电梯返回。沿路向右经过蟋蟀屠夫，左侧是开发室门，密码 θεθλβλ。海洋之丝宝箱在第二个房间，密码 θβδζκε。

items.name: 碧蓝季风
items.obtain: There's one to the south of the previous collectible but it won't open. Need to have accepted the “Precious Treasure” request to open it.
items.obtain_zh: 在上一件收集物南侧有一个箱子但无法打开，需先接受委托《珍贵宝物》。

items.name: 纯白季风
items.obtain: Replaces Blue Monsoon on NG+. Requires accepting the "Precious Treasure" request to open the crate south of the previous collectible.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换碧蓝季风。需接受《珍贵宝物》委托才能打开上一件收集物南侧的箱子。

items.name: “四秒钟”基本造型
items.obtain: Replaces White Monsoon on NG++. Requires accepting the "Precious Treasure" request to open the crate south of the previous collectible.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换纯白季风。需接受《珍贵宝物》委托才能打开上一件收集物南侧的箱子。

items.name: 墨色波浪
items.obtain: From there, head west, before then jumping up to the roof to the south. The Nano Suit is up there.
items.obtain_zh: 从那里向西走，再向南跳上屋顶，纳米战衣就在上面。

items.name: 怒涛
items.obtain: Replaces Black Wave on NG+. Found on the rooftop to the south, reached by heading west then jumping up.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换墨色波浪。位于南侧屋顶，向西走再向上跳即可到达。

items.name: 烽火神盾
items.obtain: Replaces Wild Wave on NG++. Found on the rooftop to the south, reached by heading west then jumping up.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换怒涛。位于南侧屋顶，向西走再向上跳即可到达。

items.name: 休闲水手服
items.obtain: Free the yellow box by exploding the barrels, then use it to climb up the north wall, before heading out the back and scaling around the outside of the building to get to the top. When up there use the poles to get across to the Nano Suit crate.
items.obtain_zh: 炸开油桶释放黄色箱子，借助它翻上北墙，然后绕到建筑后侧，沿建筑外壁攀爬到顶部。上去后利用柱子跳到纳米战衣箱子处。

items.name: 舒适水手服
items.obtain: Replaces Daily Sailor on NG+. Explode the barrels to free the yellow box, climb the north wall, scale the outside of the building, and use the poles to reach the crate.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换休闲水手服。炸开油桶释放黄色箱子，翻上北墙，沿建筑外壁攀爬，利用柱子到达箱子处。

items.name: 知觉套装原型
items.obtain: Replaces Comfort Sailor on NG++. Explode the barrels to free the yellow box, climb the north wall, scale the outside of the building, and use the poles to reach the crate.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换舒适水手服。炸开油桶释放黄色箱子，翻上北墙，沿建筑外壁攀爬，利用柱子到达箱子处。

items.name: 赛博绑带装
items.obtain: Just west of the Oasis Supply Camp, underwater, is a locked supply crate. Contains the Cybernetic Bondage Nano Suit Design Pattern. Passcode to get in is: λλλλαθ
items.obtain_zh: 绿洲补给营地以西的水下有一个上锁的补给箱，内有赛博绑带装设计图。开箱密码：λλλλαθ

items.name: 自动绑带装
items.obtain: Replaces Cybernetic Bondage on NG+. Found in the locked underwater crate west of the Oasis Supply Camp. Passcode: λλλλαθ
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换赛博绑带装。位于绿洲补给营地以西水下的上锁箱子内。密码：λλλλαθ

items.name: 神经元回路绑带装
items.obtain: Replaces Autonetic Bondage on NG++. Found in the locked underwater crate west of the Oasis Supply Camp. Passcode: λλλλαθ
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换自动绑带装。位于绿洲补给营地以西水下的上锁箱子内。密码：λλλλαθ

items.name: 海的女仆
items.obtain: Reward for catching all 25 Fish. Once your fish data bank is full, head to Clyde's fishing shack in the Oasis and he'll give you the outfit.
items.obtain_zh: 钓到全部 25 种鱼的奖励。鱼图鉴集满后，前往绿洲克莱德的钓鱼小屋领取。

items.name: 海潮女仆
items.obtain: Found while fishing in the Oasis using strange bait while wearing the Ocean Maid Nano Suit.
items.obtain_zh: 穿着海的女仆纳米战衣，在绿洲使用奇怪鱼饵钓鱼时获得。

items.name: “波浪”潜水比基尼
items.obtain: Available to purchase from Clyde's shop in the Oasis. Added as part of the Summer Update in Update 1.006.
items.obtain_zh: 可在绿洲克莱德的商店购买。随夏日更新在 1.006 版本加入。

items.name: “波浪”斜款连体比基尼
items.obtain: Available to purchase from Clyde's shop in the Oasis. Added as part of the Summer Update in Update 1.006.
items.obtain_zh: 可在绿洲克莱德的商店购买。随夏日更新在 1.006 版本加入。

items.name: 星球空降服（第3小队）
items.obtain: Instead of heading to the right and going to the yellow box, there's an offshoot in the right-hand corridor to the right. Head in there, defeat all the enemies, while avoiding all the lasers, and this Nano Suit is all yours.
items.obtain_zh: 不要向右前往黄色箱子，右侧走廊有一处岔路。进入岔路，在避开所有激光的同时击败全部敌人，即可获得此纳米战衣。

items.name: 星球空降服（第3小队）第2版
items.obtain: Replaces Planet Diving Suit (3rd) on NG+. Found in the offshoot corridor to the right, past the laser traps and enemies.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换星球空降服（第3小队）。位于右侧岔路走廊，穿过激光陷阱和敌人后找到。

items.name: 星球空降防护服（第7小队）第2版
items.obtain: Replaces Planet Diving Suit (3rd) V2 on NG++. Found in the offshoot corridor to the right, past the laser traps and enemies.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换星球空降服（第3小队）第2版。位于右侧岔路走廊，穿过激光陷阱和敌人后找到。

items.name: 星球空降服（第6小队）
items.obtain:
From the second Cocoon, drop down the yellow ledges and you'll be able to jump over to an island-like area where there will be a Drone Upgrade Module on top of a car. From there, jump across to the building with the pillars. You'll have to swim through the water for a little bit which will slowly kill you, but you'll make it there before you die.

Once you're across, climb up to the top from the yellow ledges on the side. Once you're on the roof, jump up to the top and go through the door. The crate will be to the left once you're inside. (If you pre-ordered the game, and already got the nano suit out of the pre-order crate, you'll only get Vitcoins out of this crate instead).
items.obtain_zh: 从第二个茧处沿黄色边沿下落，跳到一处小岛状区域，那里的车顶放着无人机升级模块。由此跳到带柱子的大楼。需要游过一小段水域，水会缓慢扣血，但能在死亡前抵达。过去后从侧面的黄色边沿爬到顶部，上房顶后跳上去穿门，箱子在进门左侧。（如预购了游戏且已从预购箱取得该纳米战衣，此箱只会开出维特币。）

items.name: 星球空降服（第6小队）第2版
items.obtain: Replaces Planet Diving Suit (6th) on NG+. Reached by jumping from the second Cocoon across to the pillared building, swimming through the water, and climbing to the rooftop.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换星球空降服（第6小队）。从第二个茧跳到带柱子的大楼，游过水域并爬到屋顶。

items.name: 星球空降服（第6小队）第3版
items.obtain: Replaces Planet Diving Suit (6th) V2 on NG++. Reached by jumping from the second Cocoon across to the pillared building, swimming through the water, and climbing to the rooftop. (If you pre-ordered the game, you may have already received this suit from the pre-order crate.)
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换星球空降服（第6小队）第2版。从第二个茧跳到带柱子的大楼，游过水域并爬到屋顶。（如预购了游戏，可能已从预购箱获得该服装。）

items.name: 朋克炸街服
items.obtain: To the south are some tracks. Get on them, head west to the end of the parking garge and then look north. Jump onto the platform around the edge and then make your way down to the surface. The Nano Suit crate is down there.
items.obtain_zh: 南侧有一些轨道。站上去向西走到停车楼尽头，然后向北看。跳到边缘的平台，再下到地面，纳米战衣箱子就在下面。

items.name: 朋克风
items.obtain: Replaces Punk Top on NG+. Head south along the tracks, west to the end of the parking garage, then north onto the platform and down to the surface.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换朋克炸街服。沿轨道向南，向西到停车楼尽头，再向北跳上平台并下到地面。

items.name: 绣球花
items.obtain: Replaces Punk Style on NG++. Head south along the tracks, west to the end of the parking garage, then north onto the platform and down to the surface.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换朋克风。沿轨道向南，向西到停车楼尽头，再向北跳上平台并下到地面。

items.name: 动力十足
items.obtain: After clearing all 6 Cocoons, you'll need to follow the objective down a red slide. There will be a Dozer and a Hydra at the end. After they're defeated, climb up the small roof, where the crate is.
items.obtain_zh: 清完全部 6 个茧后，跟随目标从红色滑道下滑。尽头会出现推土机和九头蛇，击败后爬上小屋顶，箱子在那里。

items.name: 共鸣
items.obtain: Replaces Motivation on NG+. After clearing all 6 Cocoons, follow the objective down the red slide, defeat the Dozer and Hydra, then climb up to the small roof.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换动力十足。清完全部 6 个茧后，跟随目标从红色滑道下滑，击败推土机和九头蛇，再爬上小屋顶。

items.name: 烽火装
items.obtain: Replaces Resonance on NG++. After clearing all 6 Cocoons, follow the objective down the red slide, defeat the Dozer and Hydra, then climb up to the small roof.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换共鸣。清完全部 6 个茧后，跟随目标从红色滑道下滑，击败推土机和九头蛇，再爬上小屋顶。

items.name: 奥卡工程师
items.obtain: Behind the Supply Camp (east side).
items.obtain_zh: 位于东侧补给营地后方。

items.name: 奥卡技术员
items.obtain: Replaces Orca Engineer on NG+. Found behind the Supply Camp on the east side.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换奥卡工程师。位于东侧补给营地后方。

items.name: 黑玫瑰
items.obtain: In the east corner (next to where you need to go) is a laser puzzle room. Approach the box, and then dodge the lasers and make your way to the control panel on the eastern wall.
items.obtain_zh: 东侧角落（目的地旁）有一间激光谜题房。靠近箱子，躲避激光并前往东墙的控制面板。

items.name: 天使玫瑰
items.obtain: Replaces Black Rose on NG+. Found in the laser puzzle room in the east corner. Dodge the lasers and reach the control panel on the eastern wall.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换黑玫瑰。位于东侧角落的激光谜题房，躲避激光并到达东墙控制面板。

items.name: 终极兔女郎
items.obtain: Replaces Angelic Rose on NG++. Found in the laser puzzle room in the east corner. Dodge the lasers and reach the control panel on the eastern wall.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换天使玫瑰。位于东侧角落的激光谜题房，躲避激光并到达东墙控制面板。

items.name: 目光焦点
items.obtain: After leaving the boss fight arena, this crate is in the next room, straight ahead of you.
items.obtain_zh: 离开 Boss 战区域后，箱子在正前方的下一个房间里。

items.name: 丽影
items.obtain: Replaces Photogenic on NG+. Found in the crate in the room straight ahead after leaving the boss fight arena.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换目光焦点。离开 Boss 战区域后，正前方房间的箱子里。

items.name: 神经元链接套装
items.obtain: Reward for defeating all bosses in the Boss Challenge mode on Normal difficulty or higher.
items.obtain_zh: 在 Boss 挑战模式中以普通或更高难度击败全部 Boss 的奖励。

items.name: 赛博幻术师
items.obtain: Reward for defeating Raven in the Boss Challenge mode on Hard difficulty .
items.obtain_zh: 在 Boss 挑战模式中以困难难度击败渡鸦的奖励。

items.name: 神圣护卫套装
items.obtain: Reward for defeating Mann in the Boss Challenge mode on Normal difficulty or higher.
items.obtain_zh: 在 Boss 挑战模式中以普通或更高难度击败曼恩的奖励。

items.name: 浪游剑客服
items.obtain: Reward for defeating Scarlet in the Boss Challenge mode. Requires the Nikke DLC.
items.obtain_zh: 在 Boss 挑战模式中击败红莲的奖励。需要妮姬 DLC。

items.name: 灵泉胡萝卜汁
items.obtain: Found on a shelf inside the building with a blue facia, and a beer barrel hanging outside. Only accessible after lowering the water level during the Side Mission, "Oblivion".
items.obtain_zh: 在蓝色外墙、门外挂着啤酒桶的建筑内货架上。需在支线任务《遗忘》中降低水位后才能进入。

items.name: 原味克里欧
items.obtain: Found by interacting with the Fiz vending machine on the lower level of the flooded sector. Only accessible after lowering the water level during the Side Mission, "Oblivion".
items.obtain_zh: 在淹没区下层与 Fiz 自动售货机互动获得。需在支线任务《遗忘》中降低水位后才能进入。

items.name: 劲能疾风维他命
items.obtain: On the east side of the Construction Zone, look for a blinking yellow light by a wooden ramp near the elevator shaft. Climb up and into the building above. Climb up again to the floor above using the hole in the southeast corner of the ceiling. The can is on a workbench by a red toolbox.
items.obtain_zh: 在施工区东侧，电梯井附近的木坡道旁寻找闪烁的黄灯。爬上去进入上方建筑，再从天花板东南角的洞爬上上面一层。罐子就在红色工具箱旁的工作台上。

items.name: 马奇内塔美式咖啡
items.obtain: Interact with the Fiz vending machine to have the can drop out of the bottom.
items.obtain_zh: 与 Fiz 自动售货机互动，罐子会从下方掉落。

items.name: 勃朗峰气泡水
items.obtain: Interact with the Fiz vending machine above Sisters' Junk to have the can drop out of the bottom.
items.obtain_zh: 与“姐妹废品店”上方的 Fiz 自动售货机互动，罐子会从下方掉落。

items.name: 巴伐利亚小麦黑啤酒
items.obtain: Between the waypoint and the bulletin board is an alleyway with this can at the end of it.
items.obtain_zh: 传送点与布告栏之间的一条小巷，罐子在小巷尽头。

items.name: 狄俄倪索斯-C
items.obtain: Found on the ground when heading to the Bulletin Board.
items.obtain_zh: 前往布告栏的路上，在地上拾取。

items.name: 红比蒙狮
items.obtain: In an alleyway that leads to The Last Gulp (where Su and Enya are) there's a Fiz machine on the left.
items.obtain_zh: 通往“最后一杯”（苏与恩雅所在处）的小巷里，左侧有台 Fiz 自动售货机。

items.name: 马奇内塔焦糖玛奇朵
items.obtain: At the far end of the northern plaza with the large planet sculpture in the centre, in the far right corner (to the right of Delloih), up some stairs, there is a Fiz machine.
items.obtain_zh: 在中央有大型星球雕塑的北部广场最里端，最右侧角落（Delloih 右侧）上几级台阶，有台 Fiz 自动售货机。

items.name: 雪精灵
items.obtain: To the left of the Delloih place, outside a window display with mannequins and near a skateboard.
items.obtain_zh: Delloih 店铺左侧，摆着人体模特橱窗外面、滑板旁。

items.name: 乌龙谷物茶
items.obtain: Take the rope and then ladder down to the bottom, then jump to the rocks behind the Legion Supply Box.
items.obtain_zh: 沿绳索再沿梯子下到底部，跳到军团补给箱后方的岩石上。

items.name: 劲能暴风维他命
items.obtain: Turn on 2 consoles in the area north of the Solar Tower, then push the yellow box to the shipping container in the middle of the area to turn on the final console. The chest next to it will open, which has this can inside.
items.obtain_zh: 打开太阳塔以北区域的 2 台控制台，再把黄色箱子推到区域中央的集装箱处开启最后一台控制台，旁边的宝箱会打开，内有该罐子。

items.name: 玉米谷物茶
items.obtain: On the eastern side of the Barren Land area there are two paths leading to the Scrap Plains. Take the southeast path. As you go, look for a vending machine on the left side of the path. Interact with it to get this can.
items.obtain_zh: 在荒芜之地东侧有两条通往废料平原的路，走东南那条。沿路留意左侧的自动售货机，互动获得罐子。

items.name: 庇佑之地绿茶
items.obtain: Take the path up to the north from the Solar Tower and bend round to the east, when you drop down (while still heading east), where the Racer's High Nano Suit was, you're actually going to want to drop down to the south, and then platform the way along a few cliffs and up a lot of them too. There's only one way to go, so stick on the path and you'll be at the ladder and the can in no time.
items.obtain_zh: 从太阳塔沿路向北再转向东，在原本“狂飙车手”纳米战衣处不要向东，而是向南跳下，沿几处悬崖平台一路向上。只有一条路，沿路走到梯子处即可找到罐子。

items.name: 克里欧原味咖啡
items.obtain: Go through the Wrecked Ship to reach the cliff's edge and then turn left to find this can at the end.
items.obtain_zh: 穿过失事飞船到达悬崖边缘，左转走到尽头找到罐子。

items.name: 绿比蒙狮
items.obtain: In the southwestern edge west of the nearby Supply Camp. Roll the two balls onto the switches beside the cooler box. The second ball is found in the cliffside corner to the left of the switches.
items.obtain_zh: 附近补给营地以西的西南边缘。把两个球滚到冰柜旁的压力开关上。第二个球在开关左侧的崖边角落。

items.name: 克里欧无糖饮料
items.obtain: At the northern end of the narrow gorge that creates an 'X' shape, there is a Tetrastar Chest. Open the chest and a drone with a target will pop out. Shoot it and it will move to another location. Shoot the target again after it stops in the middle of the canyon, then shoot it one final time at the south end of the canyon to get it to drop the Can.
items.obtain_zh: 在呈 X 形的狭窄峡谷北端有个四星宝箱。打开后弹出带目标的无人机，射中后它会移动位置；等它停在峡谷中央再射一次，最后在峡谷南端再射一次，罐子就会掉落。

items.name: 大麦谷物茶
items.obtain: The Can is behind a locked gate accessible by climbing above the path to the east of the entrance to Altess Levoire, then jumping down the poles and ledges in the western corner of these clifftops. Solve the pressure plate puzzle by putting all 3 carts on the left pressure plate so it reads 23 on the left and 03 on the right, matching the sign above it. Jump down the hatch in front of the numbers to get the Can.
items.obtain_zh: 罐子在上锁大门后。从阿尔忒斯勒瓦尔入口以东的路爬上去，再从这些崖顶西侧的柱子与边沿跳下。把 3 辆推车全部放到左侧压力板上解谜，使左侧显示 23、右侧显示 03，与上方标牌一致。从数字前的开口跳下取得罐子。

items.name: 汉拿山气泡水
items.obtain: Now that you have Double Jump, fast-travel to the Western Great Canyon Supply Camp and head north, and climb the cliffs to the north. Keep running, jumping and climbing until you reach the top. There's an ice chest with this can in it.
items.obtain_zh: 获得二段跳后，快速传送至西部大峡谷补给营地，向北走并攀上北侧悬崖，一路奔跑、跳跃、攀爬直到顶部，有冰柜藏有该罐子。

items.name: 橙子甘露
items.obtain: Next to the Central Great Canyon Camp is a billboard. Pull over the yellow box from the north to the steel girder. Double jump up and walk across the billboard for this can.
items.obtain_zh: 中部大峡谷营地旁有块广告牌。把北侧的黄色箱子拉到钢梁旁，二段跳上去，走过广告牌取得罐子。

items.name: 海盗拉格啤酒
items.obtain: Found in a crate on top of a lift platform on the western edge of the Northern Scrap Plains. Activate the lever to the north to lower the platform, then sprint back to the lift to reach it.
items.obtain_zh: 位于北部废料平原西侧升降平台顶部的箱子里。先启动北侧拉杆降下平台，再冲刺回到升降台。

items.name: 雪精灵无糖饮料
items.obtain: Walk to the edge of the cliff here and pulse your scanner. Over the edge, you'll see three metal beams under a piece of scrap, and a droid trapped inside. Shoot the beams to release the droid, and it will drop the can for you.
items.obtain_zh: 走到此处悬崖边用扫描器脉冲。悬崖下方有三根金属梁压着一块废料，里面困着机器人。射断金属梁放出机器人，它会为你丢下罐子。

items.name: 灵泉翠汁
items.obtain: Above the Waypoint near the Bulletin Board, you will find a collection of buildings constructed out of scrap. Use the metal ramp on the left side to jump up and across to the Can's location. You need Double Jump to reach it.
items.obtain_zh: 在布告栏附近传送点上方的废料建筑群。用左侧金属坡道跳上去，跳到罐子所在处，需要二段跳。

items.name: 巴伐利亚酵母小麦白啤酒
items.obtain: Found inside a Fiz vending machine next to a small concrete ruin on the cliff edge.
items.obtain_zh: 位于悬崖边一小片混凝土废墟旁的 Fiz 自动售货机内。

items.name: 马奇内塔拿铁咖啡
items.obtain: Located inside a chest that will drop to the floor after completing the trolley puzzle. Place three trolleys on their respective panel to drop the crate. One trolley is on the metal platform to the right, the second is to the left of the entrance by the stairs, and the last is on the upper platform at the back.
items.obtain_zh: 完成推车谜题后落入地面的宝箱内。把三辆推车分别推上各自的平台即可放下箱子：一辆在右侧金属平台上，一辆在入口左侧楼梯旁，最后一辆在后方上层平台。

items.name: 克里欧纯净水
items.obtain: Located halfway down the Forbidden Area behind the gate and fence. Go down the first two ropes and look to the west to find the gate and fence. Now, use the rubble around the edge to reach the gate, open it, and pick up the can.
items.obtain_zh: 位于禁区中段、大门和围栏后方。沿前两条绳索下去，向西找到大门和围栏，利用边缘的碎石到达大门，打开后拾取罐子。

items.name: 克里欧香草咖啡
items.obtain: Next to two blue shipping containers by the raised section of track on the southwest side of the Rail Yard.
items.obtain_zh: 位于调车场西南侧高架轨道段旁的两个蓝色集装箱边。

items.name: 新地干姜水
items.obtain: In a hidden room behind the burning tires on the west side of the Juggernaut fight arena. Go under the metal staircase behind the shipping containers to find it.
items.obtain_zh: 在巨兽战场西侧燃烧轮胎后的隐藏房间里。从集装箱后的金属楼梯下方钻进去。

items.name: 海盗麦芽啤酒
items.obtain: Found on a small platform at the north end of the flooded tunnel, past the submerged train and the chain link fence. There is a hole in the fence, underwater, that you can swim through.
items.obtain_zh: 在淹没隧道北端的小平台上，穿过沉没列车和铁丝网。铁丝网水下有个洞可以游过去。

items.name: 乔纳森柠檬味嗨棒
items.obtain: Open the chest located on top of the mountain to obtain this Can. You can reach this by moving the yellow crate over to the ledges and then climbing up. When you enter this area, a boulder will drop behind you and trap you there until you defeat the enemies.
items.obtain_zh: 打开山顶的宝箱获得。把黄色箱子移到边沿旁再爬上去即可到达。进入该区域时，身后会落下巨石将你困住，需击败敌人才能离开。

items.name: 星泉水
items.obtain: Right next to the West of Buried Ruins camp. Place a Smart Mine on the shining bit of the ground and wait for the underground Nyatiba to bump into it to dislodge the chest with the Can.
items.obtain_zh: 就在掩埋遗迹西侧营地旁边。在闪亮的地面上放置智能地雷，等地下的孽奇拔撞上它，就能震出装有罐子的宝箱。

items.name: 劲能冰霜维他命
items.obtain: Located in the chest on the small building, under the area you land from the makeshift ramp. Carefully jump between the lasers to reach the chest.
items.obtain_zh: 位于你从简易坡道落下处下方小建筑上的宝箱里。在激光之间小心跳跃到达宝箱。

items.name: 乔纳森姜味嗨棒
items.obtain: Interact with the vending machine on the ground floor, east of the Crumbling Rooftop Camp. You will be ambushed by two Tentacle and one Lurker Naytibas as you approach it.
items.obtain_zh: 与崩塌屋顶营地以东一层的自动售货机互动。靠近时会被两只触手孽奇拔和一只潜伏孽奇拔伏击。

items.name: 庇佑之地奶茶
items.obtain: To get this one, you need to solve a puzzle to the north of the Opera House. Take out the turret and then put the hover storage on the pressure plates, so that they all equal 4, 6 and 7 (from west to east). Once you've done that and got all greens, open the door to the northeast. Inside is a chest with this can.
items.obtain_zh: 需要在歌剧院以北解谜。打掉炮塔，把悬浮货箱放到压力板上，使三块板从西到东分别显示 4、6、7。全部变绿后打开东北方的门，里面的宝箱有该罐子。

items.name: 黑比蒙狮
items.obtain: To the northeast of the Opera House in the Buried Ruins, you'll find a small parking lot. On the southern wall of the parking lot, you will see the numbers 12, 2 and 13 written. You will need to move the three yellow boxes here into the parking spots labelled 12, 2 and 13. Doing so will unlock the nearby ice camp cooler.
items.obtain_zh: 在掩埋遗迹歌剧院东北方有一个小停车场。停车场南墙上写着数字 12、2 和 13。把这里的三个黄色箱子推到标有 12、2、13 的车位上，即可解锁附近的冰柜。

items.name: 珠穆朗玛峰气泡水
items.obtain: Located in a chest behind the lasers. You can get here by following the path north from the Middle Path between Ruins Camp. Push the yellow block north and place it on the right side of the lasers to block them. Note, you will be ambushed by Creeper and Lurker Naytibas while pushing the yellow block.
items.obtain_zh: 位于激光后的宝箱里。从遗迹间小径营地向北沿路前进，将黄色方块向北推，放在激光右侧挡住激光。注意，推方块时会被爬行者和潜伏者孽奇拔伏击。

items.name: 核子能量饮料
items.obtain: Behind the locked gate near the Middle Path between Ruins camp. Climb the scaffolding located across the Opera House, then move the yellow crate to under the yellow ledge in the back to access the area containing a chest with a Can inside.
items.obtain_zh: 位于遗迹间小径营地附近上锁大门后。攀爬歌剧院对面的脚手架，把黄色箱子移到后方黄色边沿下方，进入内有罐子宝箱的区域。

items.name: 无糖新地干姜水
items.obtain: Near the Exile's Passage camp. Shoot the box sticking out of the ground to reveal this can.
items.obtain_zh: 流放者通道营地附近。射击伸出地面的箱子，罐子就会出现。

items.name: 蔓越莓甘露
items.obtain: Located inside the chest on the platform. Climb the ledge lift and jump on the maintenance bots to reach it.
items.obtain_zh: 位于平台上的宝箱内。攀上边沿升降台，跳上维修机器人到达。

items.name: 妙之跃无糖饮料
items.obtain: Climb the yellow ledges, shoot the drone target, then swing from the branches to the rope, climb to the top, and reach the chest.
items.obtain_zh: 攀上黄色边沿，射中无人机目标，然后从树枝荡到绳索上，爬到顶部到达宝箱。

items.name: 克里欧抹茶咖啡
items.obtain: Northeast of the Great Desert Outskirts Supply Camp is an Ice Camp cooler. Interact with it and you'll see 3 targets appear behind the box. Shoot the central target, the right target and then the left target in that order and the box will open, ejecting the can.
items.obtain_zh: 大沙漠外围补给营地东北方有一台冰柜。互动后箱子后会出现 3 个目标，按中央、右、左的顺序射击，箱子就会打开并弹出罐子。

items.name: 焰火能量饮料
items.obtain: Northeast of the Underground Secret Passage Camp, is an Ice Camp cooler on the roof of a building. Interact with it and shoot the explosive barrels before they hit you to unlock this one. Make sure you have plenty of ammo!
items.obtain_zh: 地下密道营地东北方，一栋建筑屋顶上有冰柜。互动后射击飞来的爆炸桶，别让它们击中你即可解锁。请确保弹药充足！

items.name: 葡萄甘露
items.obtain: South of the Oasis, near a platform with a cable running to it, is a Fiz vending machine with this can.
items.obtain_zh: 绿洲以南，靠近一座连有缆绳的平台处，有台 Fiz 自动售货机，内有该罐子。

items.name: 庇佑之地伯爵茶
items.obtain: Found in an Ice Camp cooler on top of the Hypertube. You can climb on to this from the west side of it.
items.obtain_zh: 位于高速管道顶部的冰柜中。可从其西侧爬上去。

items.name: 克里欧麦芽酒
items.obtain: Just northeast of West of Buried Ruins Legion Camp is a mini-game of sorts. First, you need to shoot a floating target to drop a rope. Second, you need to climb up and power the generator. Third, you need to race to the second and third before the time expires. Do that, and you'll open the garage door below where you end up, which has a can inside.
items.obtain_zh: 掩埋遗迹西侧军团营地东北方有个小游戏。先射中浮空目标放下绳索，再爬上去给发电机供电，然后在时限内依次跑到第二、第三个。完成后脚下方的车库门会打开，里面有一个罐子。

items.name: 妙之跃
items.obtain: Behind the first camp you come to after the first fight with Belial, you'll see some pipes jutting out of the wall. Jump onto these pipes and use them to cross to the walkway behind the camp. Follow this walkway around the room and you'll reach a long pathway. At the end of this pathway is the can.
items.obtain_zh: 在首次与贝利亚尔战斗后到达的第一个营地后方，可以看到一些伸出的管道。跳上管道走到营地后方的通道，沿通道绕行房间到达一条长路，路的尽头是罐子。

items.name: 闪电能量饮料
items.obtain: Once you reach the Space Logistics Center Supply Camp, look on the opposite side of this room behind some shipping containers.
items.obtain_zh: 到达太空物流中心补给营地后，到房间对面、集装箱后方查看。

items.name: 苹果甘露
items.obtain: After entering the Raphael Space Center, you will see an information booth ahead. Over to the right is the door that we want to head through to continue. However, if you attempt to do so you will find that it is currently locked. Check the seating area to the left of the locked door, and look around behind the seats to find this can.
items.obtain_zh: 进入拉斐尔太空中心后，前方有信息台。右侧是继续前进的门，但暂时上锁。查看锁门左侧的座位区，在座位后方寻找罐子。

items.name: 月泉水
items.obtain: After climbing along the outer wall and coming back inside, defeat the enemies and the Machine Hive. Head over to the gap in the window the Machine Hive had been blocking. Rather than going across the girder here, look to the right. You should be able to spot another section of the walkway to which we can jump. Do so and follow it to the end where there will be a Fiz vending machine with the can inside. Note: If you miss this one, you can fish it up from the Oasis in the Great Desert using Strange Bait after finishing Spire 4.
items.obtain_zh: 沿外墙攀爬并返回内部后，击败敌人和机械蜂巢。走到机械蜂巢原本挡住的窗口缺口，不要走钢梁，而是向右看，可以跳到另一段通道。走到尽头有台 Fiz 自动售货机，内有罐子。提示：若错过，可在完成尖塔4后到大沙漠绿洲用奇怪鱼饵钓上来。

items.name: 访客信息
items.obtain: Follow the walkway to the right until you see a door with a broken red panel. The document is inside, on the left. Careful of ambushes!
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 沿右侧步道前进，直到看到一扇红色面板破损的门。文档就在门内左侧。小心埋伏！

items.name: 启动序列
items.obtain: After the wallrunning over the fallen floor section, it's on the floor in front of you.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在坍塌地板段跑墙之后，文档就在你前方的地上。

items.name: 你是假的
items.obtain: As you walk down the stairs when Lily says the timelines don't match up. Can't miss this one.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 莉莉说时间线对不上时，你正走下楼梯，这份文档不会错过。

items.name: 埃多斯公司宣传广告
items.obtain: In the far left room (as if you were facing the way you came in), there's a robot in there now.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在最左侧的房间里（以你进来的方向为正面），现在那里有个机器人。

items.name: 安检程序指南
items.obtain: After the symbol floor puzzle, on the right before you go through the next door.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 完成地面符号谜题后，在进入下一道门之前的右侧。

items.name: 人类解放阵线
items.obtain: In the control room where you have to open a door (after getting through the timed door), just interact with the computer on the right.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在需要通过限时门后、需要打开一道门的控制室里，与右侧的电脑互动即可。

items.name: μηλαμη
items.obtain: Found on corpse just down the hallway from the passcode-locked door in the corridor beyond the first Hive.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在第一个蜂巢之后的走廊里，从密码锁门沿走廊往前，尸体上。

items.name: 杀死母主领域
items.obtain: Once the saw blades have stopped and the fans are off, there is a document near the yellow cube on the left hand side of the room, opposite the legion camp
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 锯片停止、风扇关闭后，在房间左侧、军团营地对面，黄色方块旁有一份文档。

items.name: 繁育实验
items.obtain: In the room with both control booths, the one in the right-hand corner has a PC on in the corner. Interact with it for this document.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在有左右两个控制台的那个房间里，右后角的控制台上有一台亮着的电脑，与其互动即可获得该文档。

items.name: 发现攻击
items.obtain: From the previous camp, go into the next room and jump into the control room through the window. The document is on the floor near the blocked stairs.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从上一个营地进入下一个房间，从窗户跳进控制室，文档就在被堵住的楼梯附近的地上。

items.name: 量产
items.obtain: On top of the tall box to the right of the previous supply box
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个补给箱右侧的高箱子上。

items.name: 隔离失败？
items.obtain: After making your way through the Laboratory Ruins, there will be a document to the left of the door in the red hallway that leads to the room with the camp.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 穿过实验室废墟后，在红色走廊里通往营地房间的门左侧有一份文档。

items.name: 弗朗西斯的信
items.obtain: Found next to the Christmas tree in Xion. Head straight from the entrance and up the stairs, then open the two chests in front of the tree to receive Francis's Letter. Make sure Seasonal Events is enabled in your settings.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 位于希雍的圣诞树旁。从入口直走并上楼梯，打开树前的两个箱子即可获得弗朗西斯的信。请确保设置中已开启季节活动。

items.name: 《真相》，第3篇
items.obtain: From the Parking Tower Exit Camp, go west past the Legion 15 pods, and around the corner past the collapsed road. You'll find the document at a news stand under the covered walkway on the right side of the street, opposite the cafe.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从停车塔出口营地出发，向西经过军团15号舱，绕过拐角穿过坍塌道路。文档就在街道右侧带顶棚的步道下的报刊亭里，位于咖啡馆对面。

items.name: 绝望者的遗言
items.name_en: The Last Words of the Hopeless
items.obtain: On a corpse on the metal walkway in the swinging section near the end of Silent Street.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在寂静街尽头附近的摆荡路段，金属步道上的尸体上。

items.name: 路易的证言
items.obtain: On a corpse on the roof above the flooded area. Climb the ledges above the huge splash of yellow paint on the chain link cage in the water.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在淹水区域上方的屋顶上，尸体上。爬上水中铁丝网笼上大片黄色油漆痕迹上方的边沿即可到达。

items.name: 绝望的哀鸣
items.obtain: On a corpse inside Barker Drugs, near the locked Tetrastar Crate.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在巴克药房内的尸体上，靠近上锁的四星宝箱。

items.name: 204号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: On a corpse at the bottom of the ramp heading down from the Parking Tower Rooftop Camp.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在停车塔屋顶营地向下坡道的底部，有一具尸体。

items.name: 对母主领域的请求
items.obtain: East and then north from the camp (also north of gate 1), on the eastern wall, under cover, is a body with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从营地先向东再向北（也在1号门以北），在东侧墙下有遮蔽处，那里有具带着记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 心怀希望者的喘息
items.obtain: Found on corpse floating in the water near the Passcode-Locked door. There is a hole in the fence you can swim through to reach it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在密码锁门附近的水面上漂浮的尸体上。围栏上有个洞，游过去即可到达。

items.name: 备忘录
items.obtain: From the Parking Tower Exit Camp, turn left and head west. Climb the yellow crate at the building corner and jump to the ledges above. Follow them around the edge, climb to the platform, then use the next set of ledges to reach a hole in the wall leading inside. Interact with the pinboard on the wall to receive the document.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从停车塔出口营地出发，左转向西。爬上建筑拐角处的黄色箱子，跳到上方的边沿，沿边缘绕行爬到平台上，再利用下一组边沿到达墙上通往内部的洞口。与墙上的布告板互动即可获得该文档。

items.name: 虔诚的菲利克斯留下的语句
items.name_en: The Words of the Devout Felix
items.obtain: As part of “The Words of the Mother Sphere” side quest (from Francis, at the book shop in Xion). In the library near Silent Street.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 属于支线任务《母球的话语》的一部分（在希雍书店的弗朗西斯处接取）。在寂静街附近的图书馆内。

items.name: 《塑料之心：第3卷》
items.obtain: After heading through the library door, head left and defeat the Barnacle. This document is on a bookshelf in the corner.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 穿过图书馆的门后向左走，击败藤壶。文档就在角落的书架上。

items.name: 对天空的呼喊
items.obtain: Facing the Parking Tower Exit Camp, take a left and head west down the street. Look left past the cafe and you'll see a lamplit statue of a lion. The Memorystick can be found on a corpse resting against against it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 面对停车塔出口营地，左转向西沿街走。经过咖啡馆后向左看，会看到一座亮着灯的狮子雕像，记忆棒就在靠着雕像的尸体上。

items.name: 451号军团战士的决心
items.obtain: Go through the passcode-locked gate and look to your immediate right. Under a stream of water, you will see a smear of yellow paint on a concrete ledge, indicating a climbable wall. Jump up, and follow the path along the wall. You'll find the stick on a corpse under a lamppost.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 穿过密码锁住的大门后立即向右看。水流下方、混凝土平台上有一道黄色油漆痕迹，表示可以攀爬。跳上去沿墙边小路前进，在路灯下的尸体上可以找到记忆棒。

items.name: 302号军团战士的悲叹
items.obtain: From the camp, head left and head east this time. Next to the two enemies who ambush you past the bus, use the yellow box on the left to climb the wall and drop into the alley nearby. The human corpse and memorystick is at the west side of the alley.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从营地左转向东走。经过公交车后会有两个敌人伏击，利用左侧的黄色箱子翻上墙，跳进附近的小巷。人类尸体和记忆棒在小巷西侧。

items.name: βθακθγ
items.obtain: On a corpse on the metal walkway in the swinging section near the end of Silent Street.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在寂静街尽头附近的摆荡路段，金属步道上的尸体上。

items.name: δβμκδβ
items.obtain: Found on corpse floating in the water near the Passcode-Locked door. There is a hole in the fence you can swim through to reach it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在密码锁门附近的水面上漂浮的尸体上。围栏上有个洞，游过去即可到达。

items.name: γθαγθα
items.obtain: On the corpse of a soldier in the open building with the “Caliente” sign, near the locked gate.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上锁大门附近、挂着“Caliente”招牌的开放式建筑里，士兵的尸体上。

items.name: 244号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Power up and travel on the monorail. You'll find a body holding the Memorystick on the platform at the station when you stop.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 通电后乘坐单轨列车。列车停靠时，在车站站台上可以找到一具拿着记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 272号军团战士的目击证词
items.obtain: From the Flooded Commercial Sector camp, hug the chain link fence and you'll find a corpse under a floodlight holding the Memorystick. Watch out for a Guardian ambush as you approach.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从淹水商业区营地出发，贴着铁丝网围栏走，会在探照灯下找到一具拿着记忆棒的尸体。靠近时小心守卫者伏击。

items.name: 信徒的记忆
items.obtain: Further east from the supply box, to the right of the ladder.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从补给箱继续向东，在梯子右侧。

items.name: 249号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: In the next area, having dropped down after climbing up, in the north corner there's a pool with lily pads. The corpse is in the water.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在下一个区域，爬上后跳下，北角有个长着睡莲的水池，尸体就在水里。

items.name: 苦涩的自杀遗书
items.obtain: After using the clock to open the Club Bpemr door (1225), there's a corpse straight ahead, near a teapot and a small camp.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 用时钟打开 Club Bpemr 的门（1225）后，正前方有一具尸体，旁边有茶壶和一个小营地。

items.name: 麦克斯的记忆
items.obtain: To the northeast of the camp, up the stairs, there's a corpse there near a statue.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在营地东北方上楼梯，雕像附近有一具尸体。

items.name: 阿尔忒弥斯8号的命令
items.obtain: To the east of the pillar in the plaza is another corpse.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 广场上柱子的东侧还有一具尸体。

items.name: 阿尔忒弥斯132号的命令
items.obtain: South of the pillar (that leads to the Hall of Records) you see when you get into the area is a corpse.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 进入该区域后，在通往记录之厅的柱子南侧有一具尸体。

items.name: 阿尔忒弥斯49号的回复
items.obtain: On the south side of the area where you fought the Corrupter is a corpse with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在击败腐蚀者的区域南侧有一具尸体，记忆棒就在上面。

items.name: 214号军团战士的遗言
items.obtain: Just to the north of the camp is a corpse with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 就在营地以北有一具尸体，记忆棒就在上面。

items.name: 286号军团战士的回忆
items.obtain: Southwest of where you drop in, on the ground level, underneath a half-finished floor, is this corpse.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在你跳入点西南方的地面层，一处未完工的楼板下方，有这具尸体。

items.name: 雅典娜82号的命令
items.obtain: In the northern area of the Construction Zone (after passing a statue), there's a corpse there, inside the building.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在施工区北部（经过一座雕像后），建筑内有一具尸体。

items.name: 幸存日记
items.obtain: Part of the “End of the Nightmare” side quest in the previously flooded Commercial District (have to lift the floodgates, fast-travel to a different place, and then return to Eidos 7 for this one to appear).  North side of the river, at the lowest level you can go
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 属于此前被淹没的商业区支线任务《噩梦终结》的一部分（需要升起泄洪闸、快速传送到其他地方，再返回埃多斯7号才会出现）。在河流北侧、你能到达的最低层。

items.name: <StoryTitle_1>: : : 警告: : :</>
items.obtain: Head back to the Hall of Records, and interact with the plinth in the plaza, as part of the “Taboo” side quest.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 作为支线任务《禁忌》的一部分，返回记录之厅，与广场上的基座互动。

items.name: 326号军团战士的传输留言
items.obtain: Use the crane to position the large steel beam to the east (near the digger). Then, use it to jump up to the two openings in the wall. The left one leads to a floor with a corpse to get this transmission from.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 用吊车把大型钢梁移到东侧（挖掘机附近），再借它跳到墙上的两个开口处。左侧开口通往一层，那里有具尸体，可取得这段通讯。

items.name: 212号军团战士的疑问
items.obtain: Beneath where the lift takes you to in the northwest corner. When going for the previous supply box, on your way back you'll end up in this room where the corpse is.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在西北角升降机到达处的下方。去拿上一个补给箱时，返回途中会来到有这具尸体的房间。

items.name: 绝望的记忆
items.obtain: Inside Warehouse 77, also at the bottom of the ladder.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在77号仓库内，同样在梯子底部。

items.name: 求助
items.obtain: Inside Warehouse 77, at the bottom of the ladder.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在77号仓库内，梯子底部。

items.name: 信仰与智慧之书2:3-6
items.obtain: Inside Warehouse 77, also at the bottom of the ladder.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在77号仓库内，同样在梯子底部。

items.name: 她来了
items.obtain: As part of the Oblivion side quest, you'll head to Warehouse 77, where you'll find this inside along with the next 5 collectibles.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 作为支线任务《遗忘》的一部分，你会前往77号仓库，在里面可以找到它以及接下来的 5 个收集品。

items.name: 反对之声
items.obtain: Inside Warehouse 77, on the small section above the other bodies.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在77号仓库内，其他尸体上方的小平台上。

items.name: 忧郁的哭泣
items.obtain: Inside Warehouse 77, also at the bottom of the ladder.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在77号仓库内，同样在梯子底部。

items.name: λμακθκ
items.obtain: To the east of the pillar in the plaza is another corpse.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 广场上柱子的东侧还有一具尸体。

items.name: ααμθβθ
items.obtain: From the Flooded Commercial Sector camp, head left and cross the bridge to the hotel with the red tarp. Go right an climb up the ledges. A corpse found behind the petrified Naytibas holds the Passcode..
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从淹水商业区营地出发，向左过桥前往挂着红色篷布的旅馆。向右走并爬上边沿，在石化的孽奇拔后面有一具尸体，密码就在上面。

items.name: 220号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Follow the southern corridor to the end, and before going outside there's a human corpse on the right at the end.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 沿南侧走廊走到尽头，在出去之前，尽头右侧有一具人类尸体。

items.name: 248号军团战士的抱怨
items.obtain: After the tunnel collapses a bit, and you have to jump down onto the pipe, at the top look left. There's another human corpse there.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 隧道部分坍塌后，需要跳到下方的管道上，此时在顶部向左看，那里有另一具人类尸体。

items.name: 268号军团战士的祈祷
items.obtain: Follow the corridor directly ahead of the camp to the end and head right. There's a human corpse at the end. Also includes the Floodgate Key.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从营地正前方的走廊走到尽头后向右，尽头有一具人类尸体。旁边还有泄洪闸钥匙。

items.name: 274号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: By a rock as soon as you enter the Crater area (near the small bit of water).
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 进入陨石坑区域后（一小片水域附近），在一块岩石旁。

items.name: 失望者的哀鸣
items.obtain: After getting back on course from the previous collectible and dropping down the hole, there's a human corpse as you drop with this memorystick on it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从上一个收集品处回到正路并跳下洞口时，下落途中会看到一具人类尸体，记忆棒就在上面。

items.name: 498号军团战士的愿望
items.obtain: In the same area, head into the water behind the robot and you'll find another human corpse.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在同一区域，进入机器人身后的水域，会发现另一具人类尸体。

items.name: 158号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Once you jump onto the highway, the corpse with the memorystick will be leaning against one of the cars on the right side.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 跳上高架路后，带着记忆棒的尸体靠在右侧的一辆车上。

items.name: 196号军团战士的报告
items.obtain: From the crate, go the other way and there will be a corpse with the memorystick by the hole in the wall.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从箱子处往另一边走，墙上的洞口旁有一具带着记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 192号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: From the previous crate, go across to the other rooftop with the Cocoon and then climb onto the roof to the right. The corpse with the memorystick will be on the right side.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从上一个箱子处，跨到有茧的另一个屋顶，然后爬上右侧的屋顶。带着记忆棒的尸体就在右侧。

items.name: 292号军团战士的回忆
items.obtain: From the previous camp, go downstairs again and enter the parking garage. The corpse with the memorystick will be directly ahead, against the pillar.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从上一个营地下楼，进入停车库。带着记忆棒的尸体就在正前方，靠着柱子。

items.name: 230号军团战士的无奈
items.obtain: There's also a memorystick next to the previous supply box.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 上一个补给箱旁边也有一根记忆棒。

items.name: 207号军团战士的请求
items.obtain: Once at the top of the parking garage, this memorystick will be beside the school bus right by the ramp.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 到达停车库顶层后，记忆棒就在坡道旁的校车边上。

items.name: 282号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Jump across to the building south of the parking garage where another Cocoon is located. There will be a flight of stairs behind the Cocoon that will lead to a corpse with the memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 跳到停车库南侧有另一个茧的建筑。茧后面有一段楼梯，通往一具带着记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 埃多斯9号，你与母主
items.obtain: There's also a robot here that drops a document.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 这里还有个机器人，会掉落一份文档。

items.name: 你会如何选择？
items.obtain: On the ground inside the Atelier.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）

items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在地下下水道下层，跪在浅水中的尸体上。

items.name: 山姆的无奈
items.obtain: After sliding down the ramp and ending up in front of the old generator, there's a corpse next to it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 滑下坡道来到旧发电机前后，旁边有一具尸体。

items.name: 516号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Underneath the Legion Camp, in a dead end.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在军团营地下方的一个死胡同里。

items.name: μηλδκα
items.obtain: Found on a corpse in the sunken train carriage towards the north end of the flooded tunnel. There are two Skull Gunner and a Hive above it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在被淹隧道的北端附近，沉没的列车车厢里有一具尸体，其上方有两只骷髅枪手和一个蜂巢。

items.name: 511号军团战士的祈祷
items.obtain: Near the Hive at the top of the staircase, after passing through the tunnel after the sliding set-piece.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在滑行桥段后穿过隧道，楼梯顶部的蜂巢附近。

items.name: CT27932
items.obtain: Visit the console in The Cradle, underneath Xion after accepting the Sleeping Beauty Request and you'll get this document.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 接受布告栏委托《睡美人》后，前往希雍地下的摇篮，查看控制台即可获得该文档。

items.name: 马修的记忆
items.obtain: On the ground directly to the left of the Angel Is A Lie poster.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在“天使是谎言”海报左侧的地上。

items.name: 唐娜的记忆
items.obtain: The corpse next to the previous memorystick is actually part of the "Missing Wife" Request. Interact to get this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 上一个记忆棒旁的尸体其实属于委托《失踪的妻子》。与其互动即可获得这根记忆棒。

items.name: 阿曼达的记忆
items.obtain: From the supply camp, head southwest and there'll be a human corpse as the area opens up a little
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从补给营地往西南走，区域稍微开阔处有一具人类尸体。

items.name: DB372-25
items.obtain: Submerged in the small pond by the exit to the Wasteland. If you picked up the Lost Device request from the Bulletin Board, just follow the quest marker.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 沉在通往废土的出口旁的小水池里。如果已从布告栏接取《丢失的设备》委托，跟随任务标记即可。

items.name: 753号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Inside the cave once you dive underwater, there will be a corpse with the memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 潜水后进入洞穴，里面有一具带着记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 742号军团战士的抱怨
items.obtain: Enter the door behind the where the water had been flowing at the dam area. Defeat the Broken Droid that attempts to ambush you and then loot the corpse
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 进入水坝区域原本水流处的门。击败试图伏击你的损坏机器人，然后搜刮尸体。

items.name: 717号军团战士的命令
items.obtain: In the next area, near the dam, next to some Houndborgs.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在下一个区域，水坝附近，几只猎犬机器人旁边。

items.name: 712号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Once you've made it through the door into the facility, when the corridor forks, the left one has this memorystick in it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 穿过大门进入设施后，走廊出现分叉时，左侧那条里有这根记忆棒。

items.name: 716号军团战士的建议
items.obtain: After jumping across the sections of the floor that area falling, there will be a corpse with the memorystick right by the stairs.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 跳过正在坍塌的地板段后，楼梯旁就有一具带着记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 466号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: On the correct route, just down the rocks from where the actual route is taking you.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在正确路线上，从主路向下到岩石处即可找到。

items.name: ιθγηκλ
items.obtain: Enter the door behind the where the water had been flowing at the dam area. Defeat the Broken Droid that attempts to ambush you and then loot the corpse
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 进入水坝区域原本水流处的门。击败试图伏击你的损坏机器人，然后搜刮尸体。

items.name: 798号军团战士的建议
items.obtain: Down below, to the left of the second power machine.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在下方，第二台供电机器左侧。

items.name: 708号军团战士的怒吼
items.obtain: Next to the staircase that leads up to the way out.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在通往出口的楼梯旁。

items.name: 721号军团战士的恳求
items.obtain: When you finally leave the area, this corpse is in the airlock of sorts.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 最终离开该区域时，这具尸体在类似气闸舱的地方。

items.name: 725号军团战士的疑问
items.obtain: After the chase sequence, directly ahead of you.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 追逐桥段结束后，就在你正前方。

items.name: 775号军团战士的恳求
items.obtain: Where the ropes are, drop down and deal with the enemies. This memorystick is on the body in the corner.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在绳索处跳下并解决敌人，记忆棒就在角落的尸体上。

items.name: 738号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: As soon as you get out of the turret fire, while crossing the plaza, this one is in the door.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 刚脱离炮塔火力、穿过广场时，它就在门里。

items.name: 749号军团战士的遗言
items.obtain: Southeast from the other one, leaning up against the Information Kiosk.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从另一个记忆棒处向东南，靠着信息亭。

items.name: 凯恩的记忆
items.obtain: After entering the Raphael Space Center, head to the left from the initial entry point to spot a door with 'GATE 03' above it in the distance. In the seating area off to the right of the door, there is a Broken Droid to defeat and a corpse to loot with this memorystick and passcode.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 进入拉斐尔太空中心后，从初始入口向左看，远处有一扇上方标着“GATE 03”的门。门右侧的座位区有只损坏的机器人，击败后搜刮尸体即可获得这根记忆棒和密码。

items.name: 715号军团战士的建议
items.obtain: Head further east from the previous one and this one is slumped against some seats.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从上一个记忆棒继续向东，这具尸体瘫靠在一些座椅上。

items.name: 泰瑞的无奈
items.obtain: In the next room, on the left, by a barricade.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在下一个房间里，左侧路障旁。

items.name: 吉姆的决心
items.obtain: Next to the previous memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个记忆棒旁边。

items.name: 729号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: This body is in the southwest corner of the foyer. Same area.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 尸体在门厅西南角，同一区域。

items.name: 754号军团战士的嘶吼
items.obtain: North from the last pair of bodies, slumped in the corner of the room.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从刚才那两具尸体向北，瘫靠在房间角落。

items.name: 751号军团战士的遗言
items.obtain: You'll find this one slumped up against the south wall of the same room.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在同一房间的南墙边，可以找到这具瘫靠着的尸体。

items.name: 欢迎来到拉斐尔太空中心！
items.name_en: Welcome to the Raphael Space Center!
items.obtain: Actually in the information kiosk in the middle of the area.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 就在该区域中央的信息亭里。

items.name: 奥卡航空航天公司宣传资料
items.obtain: Just to the north of the Legion Camp, before you go through the door into the next area.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 就在军团营地以北，进入下一区域的门之前。

items.name: 251号军团战士的决心
items.obtain: On the left as you walk in through the main door (north).
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从正门（北侧）进入后，在左侧。

items.name: 212号军团战士的终局
items.obtain: Just next to the aforementioned body.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 就在前面提到的尸体旁边。

items.name: ηεγβεγ
items.obtain: After entering the Raphael Space Center, head to the left from the initial entry point to spot a door with 'GATE 03' above it in the distance. In the seating area off to the right of the door, there is a Broken Droid to defeat and a corpse to loot with this memorystick and passcode.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 进入拉斐尔太空中心后，从初始入口向左看，远处有一扇上方标着“GATE 03”的门。门右侧的座位区有只损坏的机器人，击败后搜刮尸体即可获得这根记忆棒和密码。

items.name: 759号军团战士的无奈
items.obtain: From the supply box turn around and go in that hole in the side of the storage. Move one of the yellow crates on the right so you can get through the hole in the wall, where the Legion is.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从补给箱转身，进入储物区侧面的洞口。移动右侧的一个黄色箱子，就能穿过墙上的洞，军团战士就在那里。

items.name: 761号军团战士的请求
items.obtain: Go back up the lift and carry on to the objective. This one is right in the next room off the previous corridor.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 乘升降机回去继续前往目标。它就在上一条走廊旁的房间里。

items.name: 760号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Head through the first Machine Hive and then head northeast through the next one. The body is behind the second one.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 穿过第一个机械蜂巢，再向东北穿过下一个，尸体就在第二个后面。

items.name: 743号军团战士的震惊
items.obtain: Head further in and you'll come across the body with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 继续深入，就会看到带着这根记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 719号军团战士的记忆
items.obtain: Return to where that third Lump came from and you'll find this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 回到第三只肉块出来的地方，就能找到这根记忆棒。

items.name: 约翰的追忆
items.obtain: Go round the corner, start a fight on the 2 Lumps, and another will join in behind you., there's another body under the staircase.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 转过拐角，与两只肉块开战，背后还会有一只加入，楼梯下方还有一具尸体。

items.name: 439号市民的无奈
items.obtain: Southeast of the Hidden Path supply camp is a large dead tree with a human corpse at its base.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 隐秘之路补给营地东南方有棵枯死的大树，树根处有一具人类尸体。

items.name: 78号哨兵的安慰
items.obtain: Just slightly southeast of the waypoint, behind a massive steel girder.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 就在传送点稍东南处，一根巨大的钢梁后面。

items.name: 224号市民的记忆
items.obtain: Head south from the Barren Land Legion Camp into the Great Canyon. Straight ahead is a corpse by a car (and a few Hedgeboars).
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从荒芜之地军团营地南下进入大峡谷，正前方一辆车旁有具尸体（还有几只刺鬃野猪）。

items.name: 27号哨兵的证言
items.obtain: Northeast from the Central Great Canyon Legion Camp is a small nook in the cliff face. Inside you'll find two human corpses, one with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从中部大峡谷军团营地往东北，崖壁上有个小凹洞，里面有两具人类尸体，其中一具上有这根记忆棒。

items.name: 275号市民的遗言
items.obtain: Northwest of the Central Great Canyon Legion Camp is a corpse with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 中部大峡谷军团营地西北方有具带着这根记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 103号拾荒者的告别
items.obtain: Southeast of the Western Great Canyon Supply Camp (in the middle of some red plants - watch out for the Tentacles).
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 西部大峡谷补给营地东南方（在一片红色植物中——小心触手）。

items.name: 188号拾荒者的建议
items.obtain: Carry on east past the robot until you hit a dead-end, where you'll find this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 经过机器人继续向东走到尽头，就能找到这根记忆棒。

items.name: 尤翰的证言
items.obtain: Next to the previous Supply Box.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个补给箱旁边。

items.name: 212号市民的记忆
items.obtain: Continue west from the previous memorystick and there'll be two Hedgeboars. Next to it is this human corpse and memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从上一根记忆棒继续向西，会有两只刺鬃野猪，旁边就是这具人类尸体和记忆棒。

items.name: 303号市民的恳求
items.obtain: Found on a body inside one of the containers in the wrecked ship.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在失事飞船中一个集装箱内的尸体上。

items.name: 寻找庇佑之地
items.obtain: Head northeast of the Solar Tower and climb the cliffs up to the large open area to the northwest. There's a corpse at the entrance.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从太阳塔向东北，爬上悬崖到达西北方的大片开阔地，入口处有一具尸体。

items.name: 311号军团战士的决心
items.obtain: Slumped up against the west side of the Solar Tower.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 瘫靠在太阳塔西侧。

items.name: 323号军团战士的警告
items.obtain: West of the Solar Tower is a body, at the base of a billboard.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 太阳塔以西有具尸体，在广告牌底部。

items.name: 马尔科的回忆
items.obtain: Just to the northeast of the Supply Camp is a human corpse with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 补给营地东北方不远处有具带着这根记忆棒的人类尸体。

items.name: 216号拾荒者的建议
items.obtain: Head southwest from the bottom of the lift to the gate. The human body with with memorystick is there.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从升降机底部向西南前往大门，带着记忆棒的人类尸体就在那里。

items.name: 295号军团战士的命令
items.obtain: To the left of the lift (slightly west of the Eastern Great Canyon Legion Camp).
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在升降机左侧（东部大峡谷军团营地稍西处）。

items.name: 阿尔伯特的记忆
items.obtain: Follow the path to the top to a load of crates and building materials. This dead body is on the other side of them.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 沿小路走到顶部，那里有许多箱子和建筑材料，尸体就在另一侧。

items.name: 102号拾荒者的决定
items.obtain: The other corpse is next to the previous Memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 另一具尸体就在上一根记忆棒旁边。

items.name: 160号拾荒者的建议
items.obtain: Just northwest of the Barren Land Legion Camp is a Hedgeboar by two corpses.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 荒芜之地军团营地西北方不远处，一只刺鬃野猪守着两具尸体。

items.name: 131号拾荒者的记忆
items.obtain: South of the previous memorystick, in the southeast corner of the dead end area.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个记忆棒以南，死胡同区域的东南角。

items.name: 212号拾荒者的遗言
items.obtain: Head west from the two previous collectibles, and there'll be a human corpse in the next passageway.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从前面两个收集品处向西，下一条通道里有具人类尸体。

items.name: 47号哨兵的决定
items.obtain: Carry on south up the hill from the Corrupter Boss Fight.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从腐蚀者 Boss 战处向南上坡继续前进。

items.name: 90号哨兵的无奈
items.obtain: Back west of the bus stop (northeast of the Central Scrap Plains).
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在公交站以西（中央废料平原东北方）。

items.name: 290号市民的祈祷
items.obtain: Follow the path west from the waypoint, the memorystick is between the ruined building and the rocky hill.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从传送点沿小路向西，记忆棒在废墟建筑和石山之间。

items.name: 65号哨兵的遗言
items.obtain: Cross the bridge and drop into the courtyard down below.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 过桥后跳进下方的庭院。

items.name: 搜索记录
items.obtain: Also part of the side quest, “Keeping Secrets” - part of the Su and Enya storyline. Northeast of the Solar Tower.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 同样属于支线任务《保守秘密》的一部分——苏与恩雅剧情线。在太阳塔东北方。

items.name: 调查日志
items.obtain: You'll find this as part of the side quest, “Keeping Secrets” - part of the Su and Enya storyline. North of the Solar Tower.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 属于支线任务《保守秘密》的一部分——苏与恩雅剧情线。在太阳塔以北可以找到。

items.name: 亚伦的记忆
items.obtain: Located on Aaron's corpse beneath the trapdoor. Use the nearby switch and shoot the targets to gain access to it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在活板门下方亚伦的尸体上。使用附近的开关并射击目标即可进入。

items.name: 情报：服务无人机
items.obtain: Available to purchase from D1G-g2r.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 可在 D1G-g2r 处购买。

items.name: 我将离去
items.obtain: After finishing D1g-g2r's side quests he'll leave to go to Xion. When he does, return to the Wasteland and head to the Scrapyard. On a large computer screen to the east of the entrance (under a box and by a ladder), you'll be able to interact with the screen to grab this collectible.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 完成 D1G-g2r 的支线任务后，他会离开前往希雍。之后返回废土并前往废料场，在入口以东（一个箱子下方、梯子旁）有一块大型电脑屏幕，与其互动即可取得该收集品。

items.name: 《塑料之心：第2卷》
items.obtain: Available to purchase from D1G-g2r.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 可在 D1G-g2r 处购买。

items.name: 《真相》，第1篇
items.obtain: Drop down a level and head east to the end where you will see a newspaper dispenser. Interact with it for this document. There's also a Drone Upgrade Module beside it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 下到下一层后向东走到尽头，可以看到一个报刊箱，与其互动即可获得该文档。旁边还有无人机升级模块。

items.name: 《真相》，第5篇
items.obtain: Continue on the path west from the Fiz machine until you come to a small open-area, on the north side, next to a vending machine, is a blue newspaper dispensary. Interact to get this document.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从 Fiz 自动售货机沿小路继续向西，来到一小片空地，北侧自动售货机旁有一个蓝色报刊箱，互动即可获得该文档。

items.name: 情报：阴谋
items.obtain: Available to purchase from D1G-g2r.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 可在 D1G-g2r 处购买。

items.name: 请勿打扰
items.obtain: On the front of the building east of the previous collectible. Near the ladder.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个收集品以东的建筑正面，靠近梯子。

items.name: S2RV1C2-7812的数据
items.obtain: Southeast of the supply camp is a small yellow droid. Interact with it to unlock this log.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 补给营地东南方有个黄色小机器人，与其互动即可解锁这份日志。

items.name: 114号拾荒者的愿望
items.obtain: Drop down, and slightly north of the monorail cabin is a dead human.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 跳下去，在单轨列车车厢稍北处有具人类尸体。

items.name: 82号哨兵的报告
items.obtain: South of the previous supply crate, just jump down the cliff and it's by an enemy or two.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个补给箱以南，从悬崖跳下，就在一两个敌人旁边。

items.name: 248号拾荒者的绝望
items.obtain: South of the previous area. On the cliffs to the west.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个区域的南边，西侧悬崖上。

items.name: 阿琳的日记
items.obtain: During “Stolen Treasure,” you'll have to head to the Villa in the Scrap Plains (east of the Central Scrap Plains Supply Camp). Upstairs near the bot. Part of the quest.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在支线任务《被偷走的宝物》中，需要前往废料平原的别墅（中央废料平原补给营地以东），在楼上机器人附近。属于任务的一部分。

items.name: 李的抱怨
items.obtain: Found on a corpse in the Oil Storage Facility during the [[walkthroughs/side-quests/urgent-information|Urgent Information]] side quest.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在支线任务《紧急情报》期间，于储油设施内的尸体上找到。

items.name: 杨的嘶吼
items.obtain: Found on a corpse in the Oil Storage Facility during the [[walkthroughs/side-quests/urgent-information|Urgent Information]] side quest.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在支线任务《紧急情报》期间，于储油设施内的尸体上找到。

items.name: 吴的记录
items.obtain: Found on a corpse in the Oil Storage Facility during the [[walkthroughs/side-quests/urgent-information|Urgent Information]] side quest.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在支线任务《紧急情报》期间，于储油设施内的尸体上找到。

items.name: 汤米的遗言
items.obtain: Interact with Tommy's body after defeating the Brute.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 击败蛮兽后，与汤米的尸体互动。

items.name: 高的记忆
items.obtain: Once you pick up the “Incarceration” side quest from the guy in the shipping container, you'll find another corpse in the water. This one with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从集装箱里的男子处接取支线任务《监禁》后，会在水中发现另一具尸体，上面有这根记忆棒。

items.name: 卢克的记忆
items.obtain: At the bottom of the water in the middle of the Plant.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在工厂中央的水底。

items.name: 奇怪的信息
items.obtain: Obtained during the [[walkthroughs/bulletin-board-requests/strange-signal|Strange Signal]] bulletin board request, which appears in Xion after you complete D1G-g2r's questlines. Fast travel to the Scrap Yard Entrance Supply Camp and interact with the console on the right as you enter to add Strange Information to your databank, then return to the bulletin board in Xion to turn the request in.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在完成 D1G-g2r 的任务线后，希雍会出现布告栏委托《奇怪信号》，完成该委托即可获得。快速传送到废料场入口补给营地，进入后与右侧的控制台互动，将“奇怪情报”加入数据库，然后返回希雍的布告栏交付委托。

items.name: αζαζαζ
items.obtain: Located on Aaron's corpse beneath the trapdoor. Use the nearby switch and shoot the targets to gain access to it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在活板门下方亚伦的尸体上。使用附近的开关并射击目标即可进入。

items.name: 109号市民的决心
items.obtain: Inside the aforementioned rock structure.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在前面提到的岩层结构内部。

items.name: 206号市民的记忆
items.obtain: Slightly west is a rock formation. On the eastern side is a body with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 稍西处有一片岩层，其东侧有具带着记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 246号市民的回忆
items.obtain: At the top of the building next to the Legion Camp.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在军团营地旁建筑的顶部。

items.name: 39号哨兵的决心
items.obtain: In the same area as the can above.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 与上方罐子在同一区域。

items.name: 艾米尔的哀鸣
items.obtain: South of the previous supply box, in the rocks, near the cliff face.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个补给箱以南的岩石中，靠近崖壁。

items.name: 218号市民的记忆
items.obtain: Southeast from the ruined building, underneath the overpass, between a car and a bus.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从废墟建筑向东南，在高架桥下，一辆轿车和一辆公交车之间。

items.name: 58号哨兵的建议
items.obtain: To the left of the previous collectible, by the same pile of rubble.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个收集品左侧，同一堆碎石旁。

items.name: 41号哨兵的记忆
items.obtain: Head back towards the buried ruins. North of where the Legion Camp is, on the east side is a bus (east of the Waypoint). Stand on the bus and double jump up to the swinging poles, and then onto the rope to get to the roof. The body is up there.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 返回掩埋遗迹方向。军团营地以北的东侧有一辆公交车（传送点以东）。站到公交车上，二段跳到摆荡横杆，再上绳索到达屋顶，尸体就在上面。

items.name: 388号拾荒者的恳求
items.obtain: Further south, near an Old Droid and a couple of Droid Turrets.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 再往南，在一台旧型机器人和两台炮塔机器人附近。

items.name: 477号哨兵的恳求
items.obtain: Northeast corner of the Opera House, near a bus.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 歌剧院东北角，一辆公交车附近。

items.name: 360号市民的抱怨
items.obtain: Just slightly north of the previous bot is a human, near a knee high wall.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 就在上一个机器人稍北处，一堵齐膝高的墙旁有个人类。

items.name: 内奥米的遗言
items.obtain: The northeastern most building, just at the base of it, outside.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在最东北的那栋建筑，就在其底部外侧。

items.name: 404号拾荒者的建议
items.obtain: North of the Supply Camp is a human by a Daily Grind billboard.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 补给营地以北，Daily Grind 广告牌旁有个人类。

items.name: 95号哨兵的悔意
items.obtain: Northeast of the Abyss Levoire (up the hill, near some crates and barrels).
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在深渊勒瓦尔东北方（上坡，一些箱子和桶附近）。

items.name: 71号哨兵的无奈
items.obtain: East of the previous one, inside another set of ruinous buildings. In the centre of this small collection of buildings.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个以东，另一片废墟建筑内，就在这片小建筑群中央。

items.name: 82号哨兵的记忆
items.obtain: Slightly east from the previous supply box, outside a rock formation.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个补给箱稍东处，一片岩层外。

items.name: 390号拾荒者的记忆
items.obtain: West-northwest of the previous supply box are old ruins of a building. At the top is this memorystick. You can climb up using the interior of the building, and double jump and dash from the opposite corner to get there.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在上一个补给箱西北偏西处有一片建筑废墟，记忆棒在顶部。可以从建筑内部向上爬，再从对面的角落二段跳加冲刺到达。

items.name: 779号市民的安慰
items.obtain: Just to the northwest of the camp, by the rocks.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 就在营地西北方，岩石旁。

items.name: 103号拾荒者的记忆
items.obtain: North of the ship, by a tree, pretty much out of the map, you'll find a body with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在飞船以北、一棵树旁，几乎在地图边缘处，可以找到一具带着记忆棒的尸体。

items.name: 173号拾荒者的哀鸣
items.obtain: East-northeast from the robot are some ruins. Next to the yellow box is a human body with this memorystick.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从机器人处往东北偏东方向有一片废墟，黄色箱子旁有具带着记忆棒的人类尸体。

items.name: 55号哨兵的决定
items.obtain: Northwest of the Oasis Supply Camp, next to some boxes on the ridge of a hill.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 绿洲补给营地西北方，山脊上一些箱子旁边。

items.name: 哈利的回忆
items.obtain: In the southwest corner of the Oasis.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在绿洲西南角。

items.name: 46号哨兵的记忆
items.obtain: East of the Oasis, before the Buried Ruins, next to a sign sticking out of the sand.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在绿洲以东、掩埋遗迹之前，一块插在沙里的指示牌旁。

items.name: 438号拾荒者的恳求
items.obtain: Behind the Fiz machine, on the other side of the wall.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 Fiz 自动售货机后面，墙的另一侧。

items.name: 15号哨兵的恳求
items.obtain: Southwest of the Buried Ruins, at the base of one of the pillars of the large highway overhead.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在掩埋遗迹西南方，大型高架路其中一根桥墩底部。

items.name: 任务失败之哨兵的哀鸣
items.obtain: Also on the same roof, near the previous bupply Box.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 同样在同一个屋顶上，靠近上一个补给箱。

items.name: 唔呃呃唔呃呃
items.obtain: Follow the overpass west until you see a red car by the edge. The sentinel is leaning against the western side of the car.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 沿高架桥向西，直到看到边缘处有辆红色轿车，哨兵靠在车的西侧。

items.name: 横穿大沙漠探险小队招募广告
items.name_en: Great Desert Crossing Exploration Team Advertisement
items.obtain: You'll find this one on the floor by the fast-travel phone booth in the Supply Camp.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在补给营地的快速传送电话亭旁的地上可以找到。

items.name: 泰迪的记忆
items.obtain: Located on Teddy's corpse. Although this passcode is found in the Great Desert, it appears in the Xion databank and opens Teddy's Locker in Xion.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在泰迪的尸体上。虽然该密码是在大沙漠找到的，但它会出现在希雍的数据库中，可打开希雍的泰迪储物柜。

items.name: “盖乐世”艾伦的哀鸣
items.obtain: Located on the corpse leaning up against the bed in the small room accessed by taking the numerous traversal aids around the building. Unlocks a chest in the Oasis.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在通过建筑周围众多移动辅助设施到达的小房间里，靠在床边的尸体上。可解锁绿洲的一个宝箱。

items.name: 《真相》，第4篇
items.obtain: Just slightly north of the South of Buried Ruins Legion Camp.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 就在掩埋遗迹南部军团营地稍北处。

items.name: 《真相》，第6篇
items.obtain: Just to the northeast of the supply box is a newspaper dispenser with this newspaper in.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 补给箱东北方不远处有个报刊箱，里面放着这份报纸。

items.name: S2RV1C2-875687的数据
items.obtain: East from the previous supply chest in the ruined city area.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从废墟城区里的上一个补给箱向东。

items.name: S2RV1C2-99991的数据
items.obtain: From the Legion Camp, go forward under the green light, and to the right is a bot with this document on it.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 从军团营地出发，在绿光下向前走，右侧有个机器人身上带着这份文档。

items.name: 杰罗姆的信念
items.obtain: Continue on up the western overpass to the north, and just as you come back outside, there's a body by a car.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 继续沿西侧高架桥向北，刚回到室外时，一辆车旁有具尸体。

items.name: 梅的记忆
items.obtain: South of the previous collectible is a enclosed area, which is where you need to go for the “A Treasure with a Name” side quest. This is the 1st of 3 memorysticks to collect.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 上一个收集品以南有个封闭区域，支线任务《有名之宝》需要前往那里。这是 3 根记忆棒中的第 1 根。

items.name: 朱莱的记忆
items.obtain: Also part of the “A Treasure with a Name” side quest. This is the 3rd of 3 memorysticks to collect.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 同样属于支线任务《有名之宝》。这是 3 根记忆棒中的第 3 根。

items.name: 奥古斯特的记忆
items.obtain: Also part of the “A Treasure with a Name” side quest. This is the 2nd of 3 memorysticks to collect.
items.note: 名称来自游戏数据库（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 同样属于支线任务《有名之宝》。这是 3 根记忆棒中的第 2 根。

items.name: 埃科的哀鸣

items.name: 绯红泪珠
items.obtain:
Once you have the keys and control of the cranes, use the left crane to destroy the sculpture on the wall to the left of the sewer entrance, then shift the girder slightly left. Cross the girder to grab the Supply Box in the small room behind the broken wall, then jump into the building to the left. Take out the Cricket Slasher inside and loot the nearby body for a Body Core.

From where you climbed up, look right to spot a neighbouring building you can jump to, it has Memorystick - Legionnaire 326's Transmission. Now look back at the first building to find handholds leading up. Climb to the next floor, clear the Creepers, and push through the room. Watch for a Cricket Slasher that ambushes you around the corner. The black box with Crimson Tear Earrings is in this area.
items.obtain_zh: 拿到钥匙并能操作吊车后，用左侧吊车砸开下水道入口左侧墙上的雕塑，再把钢梁稍微向左移。踩钢梁过去，取得破墙后小房间里的补给箱，然后跳进左侧建筑。消灭里面的蟋蟀斩击者，并搜刮附近尸体获得身体核心。从你爬上去的位置向右看，可以跳到旁边一栋建筑，那里有记忆棒——军团士兵326的讯息。再回头看第一栋建筑，找到通往上层的手抓点。爬到上一层，清掉爬行者并穿过房间，注意拐角处会有一只蟋蟀斩击者伏击。装有绯红泪珠耳饰的黑色箱子就在此区域。
