items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换光点。位于封锁站台第二节列车车厢左侧的黑色箱子中。

items.name: 银齿
items.obtain: In the Prestige Lounge, head down the hallway and take out the Heavy Droid along the way. At the larger room at the end, a Battle Droid and an Aid Droid will burst through the door on the left. Deal with them, then loot the black box in this room for Silver Tooth Earrings.
items.obtain_zh: 在贵宾休息室沿走廊前进，途中消灭重型机器人。走到尽头较大的房间时，一只战斗机器人和一只辅助机器人会从左侧门破门而出。解决它们后，搜刮此房间的黑色箱子获得银齿耳饰。

items.name: 金齿
items.obtain: Replaces Silver Tooth Earrings on NG+. Found in the black box in the room at the end of the Prestige Lounge hallway.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换银齿。位于贵宾休息室走廊尽头房间的黑色箱子中。

items.name: 战术包
items.obtain: The default Drone Appearance, automatically equipped at the start of the game.
items.obtain_zh: 默认无人机外观，游戏开始时自动装备。

items.name: 装甲包
items.obtain: Look behind the Memory Tower camp for a splash of yellow paint on the floor. Climb down using the handholds beneath it and make your way across the swinging bars, then climb up the other side. A small case containing the Armored Pack can be found in the red scaffolding structure.
items.obtain_zh: 到记忆之塔营地后方寻找地上的黄色油漆痕迹，沿下方的手抓点爬下，走过摆动横杆后爬到另一侧。红色脚手架结构中的小箱子里有装甲包。

items.name: 铁甲套装
items.obtain: Replaces Armored Pack on NG+. Found in the red scaffolding structure behind the Memory Tower camp, accessed via the yellow handholds and swinging bars.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换装甲包。位于记忆之塔营地后方的红色脚手架结构中，经黄色手抓点和摆动横杆到达。

items.name: 毛绒熊熊套装
items.obtain: Found in a crate near the Safehouse Supply Camp in Xion. Requires the Complete Edition or the Tachyon Pack DLC.
items.obtain_zh: 位于希雍安全屋补给营地附近的箱子中。需要完整版或“超光速粒子包”DLC。

items.name: 占星师套装
items.obtain: Found in the Deluxe crate near the Safehouse Supply Camp in Xion. Exclusive to the Digital Deluxe Edition.
items.obtain_zh: 位于希雍安全屋补给营地附近的豪华版箱子中。数字豪华版专属。

items.name: 驯鹿鲁道夫套装
items.obtain: Found next to the Christmas tree in Xion. Head straight from the entrance, up the stairs, and interact with the presents in front of the tree. Make sure Seasonal Events is enabled in your settings.
items.obtain_zh: 位于希雍圣诞树旁。从入口直走，上楼梯，与树前的礼物互动。需在设置中开启季节活动。

items.name: 辅助机042套装
items.obtain: Available from [[walkthroughs/nier-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nier-automata#finding-emil|Emil's shop]]. Requires the NieR Automata DLC.
items.obtain_zh: 可在埃米尔的商店购买。需要《尼尔：机械纪元》DLC。

items.name: 兔宝宝套装
items.obtain: Climb the pillar in the northeast and in the pipe you'll find this drone pack.
items.obtain_zh: 攀上东北方的柱子，在管道中找到该无人机背包。

items.name: 迷你兔套装
items.obtain: Replaces Lop Bunny Pack on NG+. Found in the pipe at the top of the pillar in the northeast.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换兔宝宝套装。位于东北方柱子顶端的管道中。

items.name: 下水道老鼠
items.obtain: Adam's default outfit, automatically equipped at the start of the game.
items.obtain_zh: 亚当的默认服装，游戏开始时自动装备。

items.name: 占星师服装
items.obtain: Found in the Deluxe crate near the Safehouse Supply Camp in Xion. Exclusive to the Digital Deluxe Edition.
items.obtain_zh: 位于希雍安全屋补给营地附近的豪华版箱子中。数字豪华版专属。

items.name: 我不是圣诞老人
items.obtain: I'm No Santa can be acquired from a present revealed by finding and attacking a strange Santa doll sitting among a group of snowman dolls on the stairs leading to Memory Square in Xion, as part of the Holiday Event DLC included in Update 1.010. Make sure Seasonal Events is enabled in your settings.
items.obtain_zh: “我不是圣诞老人”可通过寻找并攻击希雍通往记忆广场楼梯上、一群雪人娃娃中的奇怪圣诞老人娃娃，从出现的礼物中获得；内容为 1.010 版本更新包含的节日活动 DLC。需在设置中开启季节活动。

items.name: 艾米尔的头巾
items.obtain: Available from [[walkthroughs/nier-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nier-automata#finding-emil|Emil's shop]]. Requires the NieR Automata DLC.
items.obtain_zh: 可在埃米尔的商店购买。需要《尼尔：机械纪元》DLC。

items.name: 拾荒人
items.obtain: Head up further (to the north) and then head west and south across the bridge. There you'll find a lot of enemies and also a crate with this inside.
items.obtain_zh: 继续向北前进，再向西、向南过桥。那里有大量敌人，还有一个箱子装此服装。

items.name: 废品回收人
items.obtain: Replaces Junkman on NG+. Found across the bridge to the west and south, in a crate among enemies.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换拾荒人。位于过桥后西侧、南侧敌人中的箱子里。

items.name: 变色龙
items.obtain: In the broken bridge area, after going through the Hive infested train carriage, on the right-hand side of the next carriage.
items.obtain_zh: 在断桥区域，穿过被蜂巢侵占的列车车厢后，在下一节车厢右侧。

items.name: 夜鹰
items.obtain: Replaces Chameleon on NG+. Found on the right-hand side of the train carriage after the Hive infested section.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换变色龙。位于蜂巢侵占区域后的列车车厢右侧。

items.name: 阿尔忒弥斯
items.obtain: Lily's default outfit, automatically equipped at the start of the game.
items.obtain_zh: 莉莉的默认服装，游戏开始时自动装备。

items.name: 占星师外套
items.obtain: Found in the Deluxe crate near the Safehouse Supply Camp in Xion. Exclusive to the Digital Deluxe Edition.
items.obtain_zh: 位于希雍安全屋补给营地附近的豪华版箱子中。数字豪华版专属。

items.name: 忧郁之雨
items.obtain: Found underwater in the haven north of the Solar Tower.
items.obtain_zh: 位于太阳塔以北的避风港水下。

items.name: 雨天
items.obtain: Replaces Rainy Day on NG+. Found underwater in the haven north of the Solar Tower.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换忧郁之雨。位于太阳塔以北的避风港水下。

items.name: 寄叶九号S型制服
items.obtain: Available from [[walkthroughs/nier-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nier-automata#finding-emil|Emil's shop]]. Requires the NieR Automata DLC.
items.obtain_zh: 可在埃米尔的商店购买。需要《尼尔：机械纪元》DLC。

items.name: 休假日
items.obtain: The Off-duty outfit for Lily can be obtained at the Solar Tower in the Great Desert. Use the floating maintenance robots as platforms to scale the tower.
items.obtain_zh: 莉莉的“休假日”套装可在大沙漠的太阳塔获得。借助漂浮的维修机器人作为平台攀上塔顶。

items.name: 休息日
items.obtain: Replaces Off-Duty on NG+. Found at the Solar Tower in the Great Desert. Use the floating maintenance robots as platforms to scale the tower.
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换休假日。位于大沙漠太阳塔，借助漂浮的维修机器人作为平台攀塔。

items.name: 设计图：星球空降服（第7小队）第2版
items.name_en: Design Pattern: Planet Diving Suit (7th) V2
items.obtain: When you arrive in the Flooded Commercial Sector, exit the monorail and look to the left. Continue down the stairs here and proceed into the half-open door to find a black box containing Nano Suit - Planet Diving Suit (7th) V2.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 抵达淹水商业区后，出单轨列车并向左看。沿楼梯往下走，进入半开的门，里面有黑色箱子，可获得纳米战衣——星球空降服（第7小队）第2版。

items.name: 设计图：星球空降服（第7小队）第3版
items.name_en: Design Pattern: Planet Diving Suit (7th) V3
items.obtain: Replaces Planet Diving Suit (7th) V2 on NG+. Exit the monorail in the Flooded Commercial Sector and head left down the stairs into the half-open door.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换星球空降服（第7小队）第2版。在淹水商业区出单轨列车，向左走下楼，进入半开的门。

items.name: 设计图：星球空降防护服（第7小队）
items.name_en: Design Pattern: Planet Diving Protection Suit (7th)
items.obtain: Replaces Planet Diving Suit (7th) V3 on NG++. Exit the monorail in the Flooded Commercial Sector and head left down the stairs into the half-open door.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换星球空降服（第7小队）第3版。在淹水商业区出单轨列车，向左走下楼，进入半开的门。

items.name: 设计图：废土冒险家
items.obtain: After draining the water during the side quest "Oblivion", make your way to the very bottom of the now drained Flooded Commercial Sector. Follow this lower path to the very end, defeating a Cricket Slasher as you go. At the end you will find a black box with Nano Suit - Wasteland Adventurer.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 完成支线任务《遗忘》排干水后，前往淹水商业区现已干涸的最底部。沿下方路径走到尽头，途中击败一只蟋蟀斩击者。尽头有黑色箱子，可获得纳米战衣——废土冒险家。

items.name: 设计图：废土探索者
items.obtain: Replaces Wasteland Adventurer on NG+. Found at the bottom of the drained Flooded Commercial Sector after completing the "Oblivion" side quest.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换废土冒险家。完成《遗忘》支线任务后，在排干水的淹水商业区底部找到。

items.name: 设计图：乌莲
items.obtain: Replaces Wasteland Explorer on NG++. Found at the bottom of the drained Flooded Commercial Sector after completing the "Oblivion" side quest.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换废土探索者。完成《遗忘》支线任务后，在排干水的淹水商业区底部找到。

items.name: 设计图：赤血丹心
items.obtain: Once you are able to use the cranes in the Construction Zone, use the right-hand crane first. Use this to push the girder into the sculpted wall to the right of the sewer entrance. This will break it, revealing a small room behind. Position the girder on the crane so that you can jump across to it and then over to the newly revealed room. You will find a black box here containing Nano Suit - Red Passion.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在施工区可以使用吊车后，先用右侧吊车把钢梁推向下水道入口右侧的雕塑墙，砸开后露出隐藏房间。调整吊车上的钢梁位置，跳上钢梁再跳进新出现的房间，里面有黑色箱子，可获得纳米战衣——赤血丹心。

items.name: 设计图：翡翠热情
items.obtain: Replaces Red Passion on NG+. Found in the hidden room in the Construction Zone, accessed by using the crane to break through the sculpted wall.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换赤血丹心。位于施工区隐藏房间内，用吊车砸开雕塑墙进入。

items.name: 设计图：芍药独韵
items.obtain: Replaces Emerald Passion on NG++. Found in the hidden room in the Construction Zone, accessed by using the crane to break through the sculpted wall.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换翡翠热情。位于施工区隐藏房间内，用吊车砸开雕塑墙进入。

items.name: 设计图：星球空降服（第6小队）
items.obtain:
From the second Cocoon, drop down the yellow ledges and you'll be able to jump over to an island-like area where there will be a Drone Upgrade Module on top of a car. From there, jump across to the building with the pillars. You'll have to swim through the water for a little bit which will slowly kill you, but you'll make it there before you die.

Once you're across, climb up to the top from the yellow ledges on the side. Once you're on the roof, jump up to the top and go through the door. The crate will be to the left once you're inside. (If you pre-ordered the game, and already got the nano suit out of the pre-order crate, you'll only get Vitcoins out of this crate instead).
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）

items.obtain: In the east corner (next to where you need to go) is a laser puzzle room. Approach the box, and then dodge the lasers and make your way to the control panel on the eastern wall.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 东侧角落（目的地旁）有一间激光谜题房。靠近箱子，躲避激光并前往东墙的控制面板。

items.name: 设计图：天使玫瑰
items.obtain: Replaces Black Rose on NG+. Found in the laser puzzle room in the east corner. Dodge the lasers and reach the control panel on the eastern wall.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换黑玫瑰。位于东侧角落的激光谜题房，躲避激光并到达东墙控制面板。

items.name: 设计图：终极兔女郎
items.obtain: Replaces Angelic Rose on NG++. Found in the laser puzzle room in the east corner. Dodge the lasers and reach the control panel on the eastern wall.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG++ 中替换天使玫瑰。位于东侧角落的激光谜题房，躲避激光并到达东墙控制面板。

items.name: 设计图：目光焦点
items.obtain: After leaving the boss fight arena, this crate is in the next room, straight ahead of you.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 离开 Boss 战区域后，箱子在正前方的下一个房间里。

items.name: 设计图：丽影
items.obtain: Replaces Photogenic on NG+. Found in the crate in the room straight ahead after leaving the boss fight arena.
items.note: 图案名称来自游戏数据（zh-Hans 本地化）
items.obtain_zh: 在 NG+ 中替换目光焦点。离开 Boss 战区域后，正前方房间的箱子里。
